note: Printed claims only (Phase 5 Step 6). Wire list image-read from book2-3-4.pdf PDF p.19 (printed p.13) at 300 dpi by the author and independently at 400 dpi by the round-1 reviewer: all 9 lines match wiresPrinted. The errata sheet's BOOK II block (errata.pdf PDF p.1) lists pages 10, 11 and 14 only, so wires = as_printed and errata_applied is empty. The whole experiment (heading, wire list, figure, procedure) is on printed p.13 = PDF p.19; programs.json's printedPage 12-13 / pdfPage 18 points one page early, where PDF p.18 (printed p.12) carries the single input flip-flop and no Experiment 4 text. Script: power on and push pushbutton 5 (printed); holding it while the dial turns, then releasing it, are script choices (the page states only the DOWN case and prints no release step). Asserted: relay 5 ON and relay 6 ON while pushbutton 5 is DOWN, and the motor ON. The state vector has no motor observable, so motor ON is witnessed by the dial on Book I p.22 (book1.pdf PDF p.24) 'Current must flow through the motor to make it run and turn the rotary switch': two pass-through untils on contacts c8 then c0, opposite pads whichever way the dial turns, so passing both proves the wiper moved; 6000 ms caps cover more than two revolutions at 25 rpm. Not asserted: the relay indicator lights (not mentioned on the page), anything after pushbutton 5 is released (relays dropping, motor stopping, where the dial rests), the dial's start position (construction state, not printed) and direction of travel. Rotary geometry, run rate and coast remain profile fallbacks O-R1, O-R3, O-R5.
